name: Side Crab
notes: DRAFT for C13-2 (bestiary-plan.md). Holds up a big claw and walks sideways. Stats are TODO for the Researcher (R-BAL-8). Distances in tiles, times in ticks (20 per second).
senseiLine: Its claw guards the front. Try the side.
description: Holds up a big claw and walks sideways.

bestiary.tip: Go around to its back or side.

lore.blue: This crab guarded the riverbank stones. Calm it, and it scuttles back to keep watch kindly.
